## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish, and what is difficult or missing today?

## Desired outcome

Describe what you would like to be able to do. You do not need to design or implement the solution.

## Alternatives (optional)

Describe any workarounds or other approaches you have considered.

## Additional context (optional)

Include examples, relevant constraints, or related issues.
